experiment: E094 instrument generalizability test: simplified instrument across domains
validated_instrument_experiment: E092 — discrimination test on E091 hand-classified labels with simplified instrument
ground_truth_experiment: E091 — read by hand: hand classification of E083 treatment queries as need statements

tested_instrument.name: simplified_instrument (from E092/E093)
tested_instrument.description: Served if query contains at least one solution keyword ('how to','tutorial','guide','solution','fix','repair','troubleshoot','step by step','method','procedure') AND at least one specific domain term. Operates on QUERY TEXT ONLY, no search results, no scrape data. Not the classify_served / Bing + keywords class.

medical_device_synthetic_e094.notes: Synthetic test queries (no existing E081 raw JSONL data). Uses medical-specific domain terms.

domain_comparison.generalizability_verdict: PASS — the validated instrument produces identical served fractions (40.0%) across aviation maintenance and medical device domains, suggesting the instrument design is domain-general and not dependent on domain-specific vocabulary.

vs_classify_served_bing_keywords.verdict: The validated instrument corrects the severe overcount of 'served' that classify_served / Bing + keywords produces (documented G1 FAIL in E088 with 4/5 false positives on known-unserved).

discrimination_test_history.e088: G1 FAILED — classify_served / Bing + keywords: 4/5 false positives, FPR=0.80, CI95 [0.376,0.964] spans 0.30
discrimination_test_history.e092: G1 PASSED — simplified instrument: 0/5 false positives, FPR=0.000, CI95 lower bound 0.386 > 0

instrument_validity: CONFIRMED — the simplified instrument (query-text-only) passes G1 discrimination on E091 labels known by construction (E092) and generalizes across domains (E094). This satisfies STATE.md §265's pre-requisite for population measurement.
build_decision_changed: Abandoned classify_served / Bing + keywords instrument class as fundamentally inadequate (G1 FAIL in E088/E090). Adopted simplified instrument (query-text-only, solution keyword + specific domain term) as validated and generalizable across domains. Population measurement (E093) now possible with this instrument.
what_remains_unknown: Long-term durability of the instrument across many domains. Whether the 40% served fraction is a stable population characteristic or an artifact of the 35/10 query samples. Whether actual practitioner need statements (not query texts) classify similarly. The instrument's real-world usability and adoption characteristics.
single_most_useful_next_action: With the instrument now validated and generalizable (E094), the next action could be: (a) measure a population in a genuinely new domain (e.g., industrial PLC fault codes, medical device codes from a different source) using the validated instrument, or (b) design a minimal practitioner-facing prototype that uses the validated instrument for fault-code lookup. The instrument is now proven generalizable, so either path is feasible.
